page.overview:
Who is Lirene Doirellin?

Lirene Doirellin is an Aes Sedai and a former Sitter of the Red Ajah., Lirene Doirellin}}

She is 5'2" tall, a little shorter than Egwene al'Vere. She has nervous eyes that remind Egwene of a sparrow watching out for cats. She used to be plump, but lost a lot of weight due to her exile. Her skin has become weathered as well.

Although she is Red Ajah, her clothing only has traces of red in it. It is possible that she wishes to disown the Ajah that disowned her in her years of exile.

Lirene is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.
